## About
Arizona Differential Specialists was founded by David and Henry Leyba, and the shop has built its name on one thing: differentials. From daily drivers to custom street rods, we have the experience to make sure your differential works its best.
David keeps the team to a high standard, Henry handles custom set-ups for specific performance applications, head technician Jose Lopez rebuilds differentials and teaches owners how to care for them, and Jesus Ramirez handles installation and diagnosis.
We stock quality OEM and aftermarket parts and can repair or build what a job needs. Our customers rate us 4.8 from 278 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free differential inspection: We check for damaged gears, fluid levels, wheel rotation and the source of grinding sounds, then let you know what we find.
- Rear end differential repair: We repair and replace rear end differentials so your vehicle turns smoothly and quietly again.
- Differential fluid replacement: Fresh fluid helps keep differential gears from rubbing together and wearing down.
- Custom rears: From an everyday car to a tow rig or a show car, we build rears to fit the job.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Through our partnership with Koalafi, financing is available on qualified repairs and service.

Q: Do you only work on performance vehicles?
A: No. We service regular vehicles as well as high performance and custom builds.

Q: What kinds of differentials do you service?
A: Open and slip differentials, and we handle locking rear differential issues too.
